blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY— The Northern Samar Provincial Hospital (NSPH) in Catarman, Northern Samar, has exceeded its maximum bed capacity, prompting the facility to suspend additional admissions and urge patients to seek treatment at other hospitals with available services. In a public advisory issued on Saturday, Oct. 24, the hospital reported 363 admitted patients as of 11 a.m., more than twice its 150-bed capacity authorized by the Department of Health (DOH). The hospital said it had 302 available beds but was still operating beyond its maximum capacity, leaving no beds for additional admissions at the time of the advisory.
